payload.title: Carry Gatsby develop improvements into the Papyrus port before launch
payload.description: Anth.us launches on the Papyrus port (AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus, branch feature/anthus-integration) on 2026-10-05. Carry every improvement that exists only on Gatsby develop into the port before launch: content-review and session copy edits (content/markus-native-markup synced with content main), About and decision-models copy, platform additions, Benchmarks page and menu entry, /posts/ excerpt headlines, content redirect pages, robots/sitemap entries, and the Biased-Decisions leaderboard at /biased-decisions/.
